achillea-millefolium.note: Upright stem, finely cut leaves, flat-topped cream corymb. Feathery from stage 1.

pinus-spp.note: Woody. Cotyledon whorl, then a stepped sapling, then a tiered young tree with a cone.

rubus-spp.note: Arching cane with prickles from stage 1. Black fruit only at the last stage.

taraxacum-officinale.note: Basal rosette; spreads before it rises. Leafless scape carries a solid gold head.

viola-sororia.note: Stemless clump. Heart leaves from stage 1; flowers held just above them at stage 3.
